name: Boots of the Winterlands

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Resistance to Cold; snow and ice don't slow you; you're comfortable in bitter cold.
text: These snug, warm, fur-lined boots grant three benefits while worn: Resistance to Cold damage, freedom from Difficult Terrain caused by snow or ice, and the ability to endure temperatures down to -50 degrees Fahrenheit with no other protection.
